style: 16-bit SNES RPG pixel art, top-down 3/4 view, cozy Stardew-Valley-meets-Gather.town village. Muted warm palette: sage greens, sandy tans, terracotta, dusty teal. Crisp hard pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no glow, flat shading with at most 4 shades per material.
